verdict.rationale: Targeting non-DOM platforms through custom renderers is a fair question for a component-based UI framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only web-focused capabilities: server streaming, Server Components, routing, caching, styling and static export. Nothing shows a Next.js API for writing custom renderers or targeting platforms other than the browser DOM.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM
